item.text: CodeGraph says it collects only anonymous usage telemetry: install/index/uninstall events and daily usage rollups, plus coarse metadata like language names, tool names, counts, durations, OS/arch, Node major version, CI flag, and a random machine ID, as described in [TELEMETRY.md](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/blob/main/TELEMETRY.md). It explicitly guarantees it does **not** collect source code or anything derived from an indexed project, and also excludes file paths/names, repo names/URLs, symbol names, search queries, IP addresses, geolocation, usernames, hostnames, emails, and environment variables; when telemetry is off, it records nothing and sends nothing.
